text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After three years of working hard with North Flight in the Twinkle Series had passed,
and things had finally settled down, one day—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Wah!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer!
That boutique over there...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The clothes on that mannequin
are vintage high-end designer pieces!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: To think we'd meet in a hot spring town like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using the hot springs trip voucher won in the raffle, today I went on a hot springs trip with North Flight.
...Back then, North Flight—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "...Because it seems she can be her true self around you too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: This time, I... want to lean on you. Of course, only if it's not a bother...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They said something along those lines, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The shop staff are super stylish, too!
They coordinate patterned items so well...
It's definitely a technique I want to incorporate.
choice_data_list: (So far, it's business as usual, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps I haven't helped her relax enough to show her true self yet."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer?
Is something wrong?
choice_data_list: ...I-I just noticed there are quite a lot of people in yukata.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah, exactly!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It seems there are many ryokan
that offer colorful yukata rentals.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's gorgeous and brings out a sense of travel...
Perfect for this atmosphere!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it,
will the inn we're going to today have yukatas too?"
choice_data_list: I'm pretty sure there was one, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then... I want to see you
in a yukata, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Then maybe I'll try wearing it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "I'll be looking forward to seeing you after your bath!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Right then!
Shall we start heading to the inn?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
!
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That yukata looks wonderful on you!
It's somehow...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...You look more mature
than usual, and..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Saying that right now... is kind of cheating.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
What is it...?
choice_data_list: Maybe that was the real me slipping out just now...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Were you worried about me?
About... that.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: When I said... that I wanted to lean on you.
choice_data_list: If that helps you relax, then by all means.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...May I share... just a little bit
of my story with you?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—You know... maybe
I just want to keep up appearances in front of you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
About the me that I crafted with every bit of thought I possessed.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I want to show you... the me that I crafted,
the me that I truly wanted to become.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I can never become who I want to be.
I won't say... I've never had days where I thought that."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
However, rather than compromising...
I chose to keep polishing my potential.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I put a lot of care into this,
wearing something that I could truly love.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even when I'm bundled up like this,
it's still... me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Will you accept that... this is me, too?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So... just for today, just one thing.
Please let me indulge myself with you, just this once.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, um.
......

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Please keep telling me
how wonderful I am, always.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
My carefully chosen makeup, hairstyle,
and fashion...
Please make sure you keep your eyes on them.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I will always remain wonderful for you.
Under your gaze—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Please, make me
shine even brighter!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Please take care of it...♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, Trainer. Your collar is a bit disheveled."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Would it be alright if I fixed it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, and now it's perfect!
We look... simply—wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond
between North Flight and myself...
